comparison.objective: Candidate configures robot hardware; this record removes individual gnocchi from simmering water after they float and turns off the burner.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs coupled rotary adjustment; the record tracks asynchronous food-state changes and uses a slotted spoon for timed retrieval without direct contact.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks retained angular motion; the record checks timely removal to a plate, burner shutdown, release/stability, and no gripper-food contact.
comparison.reason: State-triggered utensil retrieval and heat shutdown are unrelated to threaded adjustment and countertorque.
